title: ophrys ferrum-equinum subsp. climacis
intro: Ophrys ferrum-equinum subsp. climacis, commonly known as the Horse Shoe Orchid, is a type of orchid that belongs to the family Orchidaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its therapeutic properties, which include reducing inflammation, relieving pain, and promoting wound healing. The health benefits of Ophrys ferrum-equinum subsp. climacis include its antioxidant, antimicrobial, and anti-inflammatory properties, which may help protect against various diseases and promote overall well-being. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions.
